PERSONA: young people texting and posting casually. Slang and shortening ("tmrw", "tn", "2nite", "sat nite", "thurs aftn", "bday on the 12th", "after skool", "this wknd", "nxt fri"), vague times ("later today", "around noon-ish", "early evening", "end of the week"), missing words, lots of typos and phonetic spellings, no punctuation, sometimes all caps or no capitals.
